title: SLEM 5 must implement an endpoint security tool.
check_content:
Verify that SLEM 5 has implemented an endpoint security tool.

If no endpoint security tool is present and enabled on the system, this is a finding.
fixtext: Install and enable an endpoint security tool.
VulnDiscussion: Adding endpoint security tools can provide the capability to automatically take actions in response to malicious behavior, which can provide additional agility in reacting to network threats. These tools also often include a reporting capability to provide network awareness of the system, which may not otherwise exist in an organization's systems management regime.
